action.objective: Verify the broad-search suggestion c3d4 at full depth: a pawn trade opens lines for our queen while keeping the extra piece and king safety.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 suggested c3d4 (exact 1407), narrowly ahead of e4f6 (upper 1406). c3d4 is the reserved candidate, so it gets up to 2000 nodes for single-candidate verification at depth 4, which is deeper than the broad search. c3d4 removes the d4 pawn (recapture exd4 opens the e-file/queen diagonal after Qb3) and reduces Black's central pressure; the extra piece from Bxd8 should persist. Verifying now before committing.
